name: Salty Cargo
note: Hawaiian staples with Korean/Filipino twists in the Hana World Market food court
flags: Yelp (Aug 2025) and The Infatuation list it as permanently closed. ZIP conflicts across sources (78727 on Yelp/Yellow Pages, 78754 in one search summary). One source mentioned a trailer at Celis Brewery, which I could not confirm. Neighborhood is approximate (W Parmer between Lamar and MoPac).

name: Patrizi's
note: Handmade pasta, house ricotta and giant meatballs in the Vortex Theatre backyard
flags: Hours are from the official Manor Road page as shown in a search snippet; Time Out had older hours (Daily 5pm-11pm). The original spot is a trailer behind the Vortex/Butterfly Bar per Time Out. There is a second location (Cuernavaca, west Austin) that I did not verify. Price and Instagram not confirmed.

name: Burrata House
address: 1201 Barbara Jordan Blvd, Ste 1280, Austin, TX 78723
note: LA-born casual Italian, burrata on pastas, paninis and bowls
flags: Yelp marks the Mueller location CLOSED (listings updated Dec 2025 and Jun 2026); Wanderlog says permanently closed. The LA-based brand may still operate outside Texas.

name: Tucci's Southside Subs
address: 801 E William Cannon Dr, Austin, TX 78745
note: East Coast Italian hoagies with Boar's Head meats; order the Italian "Tucci's Way"
flags: Official name is Tucci's Southside Subs. Second location: 7101 W Hwy 71, Ste A5 (Oak Hill). Hours are from the official contact page as shown in a search snippet. Neighborhood is approximate (I-35 at William Cannon, between St. Elmo and Southpark Meadows). Price not confirmed; Infatuation notes about $20 for a full sub.

name: Dough Boys
note: Wood-fired Neapolitan pizza trailer, 36-hour dough from Barton Springs Mill flour
flags: Community Impact reported the trailer's last day was May 29 (I could not confirm the year). It had been at Meanwhile Brewing Co. since July 2021 and started at Arbor Food Truck Park in 2020. Address not confirmed in a source. Neighborhood is my estimate for Meanwhile Brewing's location, not from a source.

name: Via 313
note: Detroit-style square pizza with caramelized cheese crust, from Detroit-born Hunt brothers
flags: The chain is open, but the flagship location is unresolved. The original 2011 trailer was at Violet Crown Social Club (E 6th & Waller). The Rainey St trailer at Craft Pride is listed as both 61 and 96 Rainey St, and the Yelp 'Rainey St' listing now shows 12005 US-290, so it may have moved or closed. I could not verify this. Hours seen (Mon-Wed 5pm-midnight, Thu-Fri 5pm-1am, Sat 2pm-1am, Sun 2pm-10pm) were undated, so I left them null. The location count is approximate (North Campus, Rainey, E 6th and US-290 seen).
